params.fraction_of_curve: Fraction of the curve length that may be filled with pieces.
params.only_full_pattern: Only place whole repeats of the pattern, dropping the incomplete last repeat.
params.num_pieces: Number of pieces placed when *Number of Pieces* is Explicit, including any caps.
params.uniform_piece_scale: Uniform scale of the pieces, applied in the chain's own coordinates before mapping to the curve.
params.map_length_using: How *Map Length* is measured: as a fraction of the curve length, a fraction of the chain's natural length, or as a distance.
params.map_length: Length over which the chain is stretched on the curve. The chain is scaled along the curve to fill it.
params.map_length_attrib: Primitive attribute on the curves that overrides *Map Length* for each curve. Empty is not used.
params.offset_using: How *Position Offset* is measured: as a fraction of the curve (`curve_u`), a fraction of the chain length, or as a distance.
params.position_offset: Where along the curve the chain starts.
params.offset_attrib: Primitive attribute on the curves that overrides *Position Offset* for each curve. Empty is not used.
params.start_behavior: What happens to geometry that lies before the start of the curve: *Extend* continues along the end tangent, *Clamp* stops at the end point (the geometry bunches up), *Clip* cuts it off. Closed curves wrap around instead.
params.end_behavior: What happens to geometry that lies beyond the end of the curve, with the same options as the start.
params.class_pattern: Explicit pattern as space-separated piece numbers, for example `0 0 1`.
params.pattern_offset: Shift of the starting position in the pattern.
params.rand_seed: Seed of the random pattern choices.
params.repeat_length: For random patterns: choose this many pieces randomly, then repeat them. 0 means no repetition.
params.piece_weights: Weights of the pieces in piece-number order, separated by spaces, for the weighted random pattern (Houdini uses a piece/weight list).
params.weight_attrib: Primitive attribute giving the weight of each piece, averaged over the piece, for the attribute-weighted random pattern.
params.use_start_cap: Use a specific piece as the first piece of the chain.
params.start_cap_piece: Piece number of the start cap.
params.use_end_cap: Use a specific piece as the last piece of the chain.
params.end_cap_piece: Piece number of the end cap.
params.exclude_end_pieces: Keep the cap pieces out of the repeating pattern.
params.rigid_end_pieces: Place the cap pieces rigidly at the middle of their position instead of bending them.
params.base_scale: Base scale factor for the cross-section of the chain when scaling is enabled.
params.scale_attrib: Numeric attribute on the curve points that multiplies the scale, interpolated along the curve. Empty is not used.
params.enable_rotation: Rotate the pieces about the curve direction by the base rotation and rotation attribute.
params.base_rotation: Rotation about the curve direction in degrees, multiplied by the rotation attribute when one is set.
params.rotation_attrib: Numeric attribute on the curve points that multiplies the base rotation, interpolated along the curve.
params.forward_x: Direction in the source geometry that is the chain direction when *Forward Direction* is Custom.
params.up_dir: Axis of the source geometry that points up in the curve frame.
params.upaxis_x: Custom up axis of the source geometry.
params.center_on_curve: Center each piece's cross-section on the curve.
params.piece_rotation: Rotation about the curve direction applied cumulatively: piece k is rotated by k times this angle, in degrees.
params.curve_up_control: Up vector at the start of the curve: the curve normal, an axis, or the custom vector.
params.position_attrib: Name of a point attribute that receives the position (arc length) along the curve. Empty writes none.
params.index_attrib: Name of a point attribute that receives the index of the piece in the chain. Empty writes none.
params.curvenum_attrib: Name of a point attribute that receives the number of the source curve. Empty writes none.
params.copy_attribute: Name of the copy number attribute. Empty writes none.
params.enable_deformation: Deform the pieces along the curve. When off, the chain is laid out straight along world Z, with z being the arc-length coordinate, so that it can be deformed later.
params.repeat_pattern: How pieces are chosen: cycle in order, an explicit list, random, random weighted by the weights list, or random weighted by a primitive attribute.
params.forward_dir: Axis of the source geometry that runs along the chain.
params.attribs_to_transform: Pattern of vector point attributes (such as `N`) that are rotated into the curve frame along with the pieces.

PCG_Chain.houdini_notes: Deform Along Curve corresponds to Houdini's Chain. Rigid Links is the plugin's own earlier method, which places whole links rigidly on the chord.
